messages:
arjun: heads-up: onboarding sample-app is getting duplicate documents in the vector DB when we run the upsert flow. curl -> single upsert, SDK -> duplicates.

felix: can you paste the requests? this sounds like an idempotency key problem.

arjun: repro with curl (works as expected):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/upsert \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: doc-12345' \
  -d '{"documents":[{"id":"doc-123","text":"hello"}], "on_conflict":"merge"}'
```
responds 200, single doc present in DB (merge semantics applied).

arjun: sdk snippet (ruby-sdk v0.3.2) used in sample-app:
```rb
client.embeddings.upsert(
  documents: [{ id: 'doc-123', text: 'hello' }],
  overwrite: false
)
```
results: two records for doc-123 in DB (doc-123, doc-123-1).

maya: interesting. REST supports `on_conflict` with options `merge|fail|replace` but most SDKs historically exposed a boolean `overwrite` flag. If REST added `merge` semantics recently the SDK mapping may be lossy.

felix: also check headers: are we sending an Idempotency-Key from the SDK? upsert is a POST so without idempotency-key retries or auth-refresh replay can cause duplicates.

arjun: sample-app uses the default client and doesn't set Idempotency-Key. curl had it. Logs show sequence: POST -> 200; then client retried the POST because the SDK got a 502 on the follow-up status check and retried the same upsert without idempotency-key -> duplicate.

tanya: two problems then: 1) param parity: REST `on_conflict` not surfaced in Ruby SDK (only overwrite boolean), 2) idempotency key not easy to set in SDK or not documented, leading to duplicates on retry/replay.

maya: proposal: expose on_conflict (snake_case on wire, camelCase in SDK) as an enum in each SDK so callers can choose merge/fail/replace. Add a convenience to auto-generate and attach an Idempotency-Key per upsert if caller doesn't provide one, with an opt-out. That would make upserts safer by default.

felix: caution: auto-idempotency-key is helpful but could mask cases where caller expects dedup by their own keys. Make the key derivation predictable (e.g., sha256 of sorted doc ids + env + request body) and document it. Also ensure hooks to opt-out for low-level clients.

arjun: secondarily, update SDK retry logic: treat a 200 with follow-up 502 from status check differently — we should not blindly replay a non-idempotent POST unless idempotency-key present.

tanya: agree. Action items: (A) add onConflict enum support to ruby-sdk, python-sdk, and go-sdk (map camelCase -> snake_case on wire), (B) introduce Idempotency-Key header support in SDKs and expose in public call signature, (C) add auto-idempotency-key generation with opt-out in the high-level client, (D) update retry/auth middleware to avoid replaying POSTs without idempotency-key, and (E) add integration tests in sample-app that exercise 502-followed-by-retry and verify no duplicates when idempotency is present.

felix: I'll file a cross-sdk parity ticket and a runtime infra ticket for the retry behavior. arjun, can you attach staging logs and the DB snapshot showing duplicates?

arjun: logs attached in issue. interesting note: go-sdk already had a low-level header passthrough that allowed setting Idempotency-Key but no high-level convenience. ruby and python lacked it entirely.

maya: let's prioritize (D) and (B) as P0 to stop data loss. Parity (A) is P1 for feature correctness. CI owners: tagging release cycle — last patch today at 1800 UTC.

tanya: I'll start a ruby-sdk PR to add onConflict and header support (ruby-sdk#210). felix, please open infra#342 for middleware change. arjun, can you add a sample-app e2e that uses explicit Idempotency-Key and verifies single upsert?

arjun: on it. also updating sample-app README to show best practice: always set Idempotency-Key on upserts or rely on SDK auto-key.

idempotency-bot: created issue infra#342: "Do not replay non-idempotent POSTs without Idempotency-Key on auth-refresh/retry" at 2175001500

felix: thanks. leaving this thread open until infra change + SDK PRs land and sample-app tests pass. :white_check_mark:
